|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[AT-M6 Cannon]] (version 2 of 2). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).

* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). If total destiny +1 &gt; defense value, target hit, its forfeit is cumulatively -3 and, if during battle, opponent's characters and vehicles there are cumulatively power -1.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[AT-M6 Cannon]] (Original). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings).
